schema_version: 1
registry_id: child-project-governance-gate-applicability-classes
name: Child project governance gate applicability classes
purpose: Controlled applicability and execution-result vocabulary for child project governance gate planning.

applicability_classes:
  - id: always_required
    label: Always required
    description: Gate applies to every managed target before capability-specific gates are considered.
    default_when_not_triggered: fail

  - id: capability_required
    label: Capability required
    description: Gate applies when declared or detected capabilities match the gate requirements.
    default_when_not_triggered: not_applicable

  - id: declared_if_present
    label: Declared if present
    description: Capability or artifact must be declared when present in the project.
    default_when_not_triggered: not_applicable

  - id: planned_until_method_available
    label: Planned until method available
    description: Gate is applicable by governance model but remains planned until the corresponding method implementation exists.
    default_when_not_triggered: planned

  - id: platform_self_required
    label: Platform self required
    description: Gate must be exercised against threat-forge itself when the platform implements the governed capability.
    default_when_not_triggered: fail

  - id: platform_only
    label: Platform only
    description: Gate applies only to threat-forge platform operational capabilities and not to child project canonical content.
    default_when_not_triggered: not_applicable

  - id: child_project_required
    label: Child project required
    description: Gate applies to managed child projects when the child governance profile selects it.
    default_when_not_triggered: fail

  - id: demo_required
    label: Demo required
    description: Gate must have a demo child project or fixture validation surface before it is used for production child project governance.
    default_when_not_triggered: fail

  - id: not_applicable_with_evidence
    label: Not applicable with evidence
    description: Gate may be skipped only when the execution plan records a reason and evidence for non-applicability.
    default_when_not_triggered: not_applicable

  - id: unsupported_with_warning
    label: Unsupported with warning
    description: Gate detects a present capability that threat-forge cannot yet validate and must report a warning rather than silent success.
    default_when_not_triggered: warning

execution_result_statuses:
  - id: pass
    label: Pass
    description: Gate executed and succeeded.

  - id: fail
    label: Fail
    description: Gate executed or was mandatory and failed.

  - id: warning
    label: Warning
    description: Gate produced a non-blocking warning or unsupported capability notice.

  - id: planned
    label: Planned
    description: Gate is applicable by model but waits for a later analysis or tooling implementation.

  - id: not_applicable
    label: Not applicable
    description: Gate does not apply and must include reason and evidence.

  - id: unsupported
    label: Unsupported
    description: Capability is present but no implementation adapter exists yet.

schema_version: 1
registry_id: child-project-governance-capabilities
name: Child project governance capabilities
purpose: Controlled capability vocabulary used by child project governance profiles and gate applicability planning.

capability_states:
  - id: declared
    label: Declared
    description: Capability is explicitly declared by the project model.

  - id: detected
    label: Detected
    description: Capability is detected from governed repository evidence.

  - id: not_present
    label: Not present
    description: Capability is explicitly absent or not detected with sufficient evidence.

  - id: unknown
    label: Unknown
    description: Capability has not yet been evaluated.

  - id: unsupported
    label: Unsupported
    description: Capability exists but threat-forge has no validator or adapter for it yet.

governance_capabilities:
  - id: project_model
    label: Project Model
    description: Project contains the governed Doc-as-Code project model skeleton, registries, graph and body files.
    category: baseline

  - id: source_code
    label: Source code
    description: Project contains implementation source files, scripts, tools or runtime code that must be traceable when present.
    category: implementation

  - id: backend_api
    label: Backend API
    description: Project exposes backend service endpoints or contracts such as OpenAPI or AsyncAPI.
    category: implementation

  - id: frontend_ui
    label: Frontend UI
    description: Project contains a user interface such as a browser frontend or application shell.
    category: implementation

  - id: persistent_storage
    label: Persistent storage
    description: Project persists operational or application state in files, SQLite, database adapters or external stores.
    category: runtime

  - id: data_pipeline
    label: Data pipeline
    description: Project ingests, transforms, exports or schedules data processing flows.
    category: runtime

  - id: ai_pipeline
    label: AI pipeline
    description: Project contains model, prompt, inference, evaluation or AI runtime behavior.
    category: analysis

  - id: rag_pipeline
    label: RAG pipeline
    description: Project retrieves contextual knowledge through indexes, vector stores or document sources for AI use.
    category: analysis

  - id: agentic_tools
    label: Agentic tools
    description: Project lets AI or automation invoke tools, actions or side-effecting operations.
    category: analysis

  - id: deployment
    label: Deployment
    description: Project contains deployment descriptors, runtime environment configuration or infrastructure definitions.
    category: operations

  - id: ci_cd
    label: CI/CD
    description: Project contains automation workflows for build, test, release or deployment.
    category: operations

  - id: external_integrations
    label: External integrations
    description: Project communicates with third-party systems, APIs, services or external trust boundaries.
    category: runtime

  - id: sensitive_data
    label: Sensitive data
    description: Project handles data with confidentiality, privacy, security or business sensitivity.
    category: analysis

  - id: regulated_data
    label: Regulated data
    description: Project handles data governed by explicit legal, compliance or policy constraints.
    category: analysis

  - id: runtime_operations
    label: Runtime operations
    description: Project has operational runtime concerns such as monitoring, logs, jobs, incidents or production support.
    category: operations

  - id: child_project_management
    label: Child project management
    description: threat-forge platform capability for registering, viewing, checking and reporting managed child projects.
    category: platform

schema_version: 1
registry_id: child-project-governance-validation-surfaces
name: Child project governance validation surfaces
purpose: Controlled validation surfaces proving that governance gates developed by threat-forge are exercised inside threat-forge.

validation_surfaces:
  - id: threat_forge_repo_check
    label: Threat-forge repository check
    description: Gate is exercised by the governed repository check command.
    evidence_kind: command
    command: npm run repo:check

  - id: project_model_pages
    label: Project Model pages generation
    description: Gate is visible through generated project-model page counts and collection rendering.
    evidence_kind: command
    command: npm run docs:pages

  - id: negative_fixtures
    label: Negative fixtures
    description: Gate has isolated invalid fixtures proving fail-closed diagnostics.
    evidence_kind: fixture
    command: self-test fixture execution

  - id: demo_child_project_workspace
    label: Demo child project workspace
    description: Gate is exercised against the resettable demo child project workspace or seed.
    evidence_kind: demo_workspace
    command: npm run docs:child-project-demo-workspace

  - id: temporary_sqlite_self_test
    label: Temporary SQLite self-test
    description: Gate uses a temporary isolated SQLite database and leaves default runtime state untouched.
    evidence_kind: self_test
    command: npm run docs:child-project-demo-registration

  - id: child_project_management_api_self_test
    label: Child Project Management API self-test
    description: Gate starts a bounded local API server on an ephemeral port and validates read-only endpoints.
    evidence_kind: self_test
    command: npm run docs:child-project-management-api-serve

  - id: generated_snapshot
    label: Generated frontend snapshot
    description: Gate is exercised by the Project Documentation Explorer generated frontend snapshot.
    evidence_kind: generated_artifact
    command: npm run frontend:project-documentation-explorer:snapshot

  - id: runtime_unit_tests
    label: Runtime unit tests
    description: Gate is exercised by runtime tests in the governed repository check.
    evidence_kind: test
    command: npm run test:runtime

  - id: registry_contract_validator
    label: Child project governance registry contract validator
    description: Gate is exercised by the registry contract validator and its negative fixtures.
    evidence_kind: validator
    command: npm run docs:child-project-governance-registries
